title: MH FileOS Action Plan v1
description: Immutable proposed action plan produced by the domain layer for user review (Approval Gate). No field in this schema authorizes execution; a later gated executor validates freshness, scope, and protected zones before any mutation.

schema.description: Schema version tag. Bumped on any breaking field change.

actions.description: Ordered proposed actions. Insertion order is significant and preserved.

kind.description: Typed operation. stage_for_deletion moves to Quarantine (ADR-005) and requires a checksum.

source.description: Display source path, preserved exactly as supplied.

source_cmp.description: Normalized comparison representation of the source used for structural checks.

destination.description: Display destination path, preserved exactly as supplied.

destination_cmp.description: Normalized comparison representation of the destination used for structural checks.

checksum.description: Expected content digest a later verifier must observe. Required (non-null) for stage_for_deletion.
